answer.question: What campus events does Icanio Tech School run?
answer.answer: Icanio Tech School runs four main kinds of campus events: MoU signing ceremonies with colleges, hands-on technical workshops, value added courses and industry guest lectures. It also runs career guidance sessions and industrial visits. Practising Icanio engineers lead every event, and each one is planned with college faculty to fit the academic calendar and give students real industry exposure.

sections.heading: What our September campus events achieved
paragraphs: The September tour covered six campuses in four days. Five of these campus events were MoU signings, which formally started long-term partnerships. Each signing sets up a calendar of workshops, value added courses, guest lectures and internship options for the college.

At Velalar College of Engineering & Technology and AVS Engineering College, the signing was followed by an industry session. Students heard from Icanio experts about current roles, skills and hiring expectations. At Sri Shanmugha College of Engineering & Technology, a guest talk gave students a view beyond the classroom.

The tour ended at Er. Perumal Manimekalai College of Engineering in Hosur with a career guidance session. It helped students explore their options and plan their next steps. For each new partner, the next stage is planning the first programs with faculty.

sections.heading: Why campus events make a difference for students
paragraphs: Many students in Tamil Nadu never meet a working software engineer before their first interview. A single guest lecture can change that. It shows students what the job looks like, which skills matter and how to prepare.

Hands-on campus events go further. In a workshop or value added course, students write code, use real tools and get feedback from someone who does this work every day. That early exposure helps them choose a track with confidence.

In our experience, the strongest results come when campus events connect to a next step. A student who enjoys a Coding with AI workshop can move into our AI & ML internship. A college that likes a guest lecture can plan an MoU for the full year.

faqs.q: What kinds of campus events does Icanio Tech School offer?
faqs.a: We run MoU signing ceremonies, technical workshops, value added courses, guest lectures, career guidance sessions and faculty development programs. We also host industrial visits at Icanio. Colleges can choose one format or plan several across a semester.

faqs.q: Which colleges did you visit in September 2026?
faqs.a: From 15 to 18 September 2026, our team visited SNS College of Technology, JCT College of Engineering & Technology, Velalar College of Engineering & Technology, Sri Shanmugha College of Engineering & Technology, AVS Engineering College and Er. Perumal Manimekalai College of Engineering.

Practising engineers, architects and product managers from Icanio Technologies lead every session. Each has at least three years of client delivery experience and is background verified by Icanio HR. Your faculty co-facilitate on campus.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.a: Contact us as early as you can, ideally when you plan your semester calendar. That gives our team time to match a trainer, align the topic with your faculty and schedule around exams. Our team replies to every enquiry within one working day.

faqs.q: Can campus events be held online?
faqs.a: Many formats, such as guest lectures and some workshops, can run online. Hands-on value added courses work best in your college lab. Tell us your constraints and we will suggest the right mode.

faqs.q: Do students get a certificate for attending?
faqs.a: Certification depends on the format. Value added courses and internships lead to an Icanio Tech School certificate on completion. MoU colleges also have access to joint certification initiatives. Our team will confirm the details for your event.

faqs.q: What topics are popular for workshops?
faqs.a: Recent workshops include Coding with AI and hands-on sessions on web development and data science. Value added courses have covered Generative AI and .NET. We can also tailor topics to your department and syllabus.

faqs.q: How do campus events lead to internships?
faqs.a: Students who enjoy an event can apply for one of our 15 internship tracks. MoU colleges get priority access and free or sponsored internship options. Our team shares details with your placement cell after each event.

faqs.q: Can our college host campus events without an MoU?
faqs.a: Yes. Many colleges begin with a single guest lecture or workshop before signing an MoU. It lets students and faculty see the format first. If the event goes well, our team can help you plan an MoU for regular programs across the year.

takeaways: Icanio Tech School runs campus events across Tamil Nadu: MoU signings, workshops, value added courses and guest lectures.
From 15 to 18 September 2026, our team visited six colleges for MoUs, industry sessions and career guidance.
Practising Icanio engineers lead every event, with faculty co-facilitating on campus.
Guest lectures and workshops are easy starting points, and MoUs set up programs for the full year.
Events connect to next steps such as internships, value added courses and faculty programs.
conclusion: Good campus events do more than fill an auditorium. They show students what industry work looks like and give them a clear next step.
If you want to bring a workshop, lecture or MoU signing to your college, send an enquiry. Our team will plan it with your faculty.
